$comment: Pre-merge Lighthouse budget, graded against a LOCAL production build by scripts/check-lighthouse-budget.mjs. This is a relative gate: absolute web-vitals thresholds are meaningless without network latency, so it compares each route to a committed known-good baseline. Refresh only through the CI refresh artifact after an intentional, known-good run. Distinct from .github/workflows/live-web-vitals.yml, which measures the deployed origin. Enforcement was promoted after complete pinned-browser baselines on 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-13 remained within tolerance.
$lighthouseVersion: Pinned exactly, not `lighthouse@12`: a patch published between a baseline run and its follow-up would silently change the measurement. Kept in step with LIGHTHOUSE_VERSION in .github/workflows/live-web-vitals.yml by tests/check-lighthouse-budget.test.ts so the two Lighthouse entry points cannot drift apart.

$routes: Only surfaces that still render. `/therapy-compass`, `/dsm` and `/forms` were removed when home consolidation turned them into redirect stubs: Lighthouse followed the 307 and graded `/?mode=<id>` against a baseline captured on the retired detailed home, which the checker reports as "measured a different page than requested". All three now render the same shared home as `/`, so removing them costs duplication rather than coverage. Restoring per-mode coverage means measuring the `<mode>/search` results routes, and those need baseline rows the dispatch-only refresh job records — do that rather than hand-writing numbers. `/my-day`, `/on-call` and `/psychiatry/mha-clock` joined on 2026-10-26 (performance audit M3): they were unguarded, which is how slow My Day loads and the On Call layout shift went unnoticed. Their own on-load API handlers are not carved into perfInitialLoadApiPatterns, so a change to one of those handlers alone does not trigger this job.
